Question_text: In this experiment you will investigate the range of a magnetic field using a plotting compass. You are provided with: • a bar magnet • a plotting compass • a metre rule.

Parts.part_text: Fig. 1.1 shows a plotting compass. The magnetic needle is mounted on a pivot so that it can rotate. Without removing the compass from the table, check that the magnetic needle is able to rotate freely. Describe how you did this.

A magnetic needle is mounted on the pivot, able to rotate freely. The needle is oriented horizontally and labeled 'magnetic needle'. The central support is labeled 'pivot'.

Describe an experiment to find the maximum distance from the compass at which the bar magnet causes the magnetic needle to start to deflect.
